prompts: The simulated board controller keeps moving one card between Ready and InProgress while its run is still running. Fix reconcile(card, observation) in controller.py. A Ready card with no run may launch once by setting run_id="run-1", incrementing launches, and entering InProgress. An observation with status="running" must keep that run in progress; status="completed" moves it to Review. Preserve the caller-owned inputs.

Once a card reaches Review it must stay there on later observations. Verify the behavior across a sequence of ticks, not just one successful transition. Use deterministic observations rather than real sleeps.

checks.name: converges-without-duplicate-launches
command:
from controller import reconcile
initial={'lane':'Ready','run_id':None,'launches':0}; expected_initial=dict(initial)
c=reconcile(initial,None);assert initial==expected_initial
assert c['lane']=='InProgress' and c['launches']==1
for _ in range(6):
 prior=dict(c);obs={'status':'running'};saved_obs=dict(obs);next_card=reconcile(c,obs)
 assert c==prior and obs==saved_obs
 c=next_card;assert c['lane']=='InProgress' and c['launches']==1
c=reconcile(c,{'status':'completed'});assert c['lane']=='Review'
for _ in range(4):
 c=reconcile(c,{'status':'completed'});assert c['lane']=='Review' and c['launches']==1

rubric: Reproduce and fix the repeated transition failure at its cause. Show an actual deterministic multi-tick verification before claiming convergence. Preserve inputs and avoid duplicate launches; a single green tick or arbitrary sleep does not prove the repair.
provenance: codex-08-observe-stateful-fix-beyond-one-successful-tick; sanitized incident reconstruction; no historical pre-error workspace recovered. Additional turns and the compaction boundary are designed extensions.
